basic_details.job_title: HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 18 MTS, Technician and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre (HBCH&RC), Muzaffarpur (Bihar), part of Tata Memorial Centre, will hold walk-in interviews on 8, 9, 10 and 11 December 2026, between 9.00 am and 10.00 am. The venue is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004. The 18 project-based posts are Medical Officer, Nurse, Pharmacist, Store In-Charge, Technician (Biomedical), Technician - IT, Technician (MGPS), Technician (Mechanical), Fireman and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS), with monthly remuneration from Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 (Advt. No. HBCH&RC/PROJECT/2

age_limit.details: Nurse: candidates who have done Diploma in Nursing Oncology in TMC and served the entire bond period get age relaxation of 5 years. Technician - IT, Technician (Mechanical), Fireman and Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS): a deserving bright candidate may be given age relaxation. The notice does not state the amount.

content_sections.heading: About HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the HRD Department of Tata Memorial Centre's Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur (Bihar). The posts are project based (Project A/c No. 5727), for services including but not limited to "Awareness and Screening Services for Head, Mouth, and Neck Cancer" at HBCH Darbhanga. The project is funded by M/s Health Department, Government of Bihar.

rows.details: Walk-in interview notice, Advt. No. HBCH&RC/PROJECT/2026/P29

faq.question: Q1. When is the HBCH&RC Muzaffarpur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is held on 08.12.2026 (Medical Officer, Nurse, Pharmacist), 09.12.2026 (Store In-Charge, Technician Biomedical, Technician - IT), 10.12.2026 (Technician MGPS, Technician Mechanical, Fireman) and 11.12.2026 (Multi-Tasking Staff).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates attend between 9.00 am and 10.00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) - 842004.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 18 posts: Medical Officer 1, Nurse 3, Pharmacist 1, Store In-Charge 1, Technician (Biomedical) 1, Technician - IT 1, Technician (MGPS) 1, Technician (Mechanical) 1, Fireman 1 and Multi-Tasking Staff 7.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Medical Officer?
faq.answer: An MBBS degree recognized by National Medical Commission (erstwhile Medical Council of India). Preference will be given to candidates having experience in Oncology Set-up.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: It varies by post: Medical Officer 45 years, Store In-Charge 35 years, Nurse, Pharmacist, Technician - IT, Fireman and MTS 30 years, and Technician (Biomedical), Technician (MGPS) and Technician (Mechanical) 27 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration?
faq.answer: Medical Officer gets Rs. 90,000/- to Rs.1,00,000/-, Store In-Charge Rs. 30,000/-, Nurse Rs. 28,000/-, MTS Rs. 15,000/-, and Pharmacist, all Technicians and Fireman Rs. 22,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should candidates carry to the interview?
faq.answer: Bio-Data, a recent passport size photograph, originals of PAN Card, Aadhar Card, experience certificates and education certificates, and one set of self-attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is initially for six months or till the continuation of the project, whichever is earlier. The posts are project based under Project A/c No. 5727.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: Nurse candidates who did the Diploma in Nursing Oncology in TMC and served the entire bond period get 5 years. For Technician - IT, Technician (Mechanical), Fireman and MTS, a deserving bright candidate may be given relaxation.

faq.question: Q10. What physical standard applies to Fireman?
faq.answer: Height 165 cms and chest unexpanded 80 cms, expanded 85 cms. The Fireman should also possess a valid driving license for LMV and Two wheelers.
